note: Controlled vocabulary of playbook actions (paper Section V: 'executable security actions from a controlled vocabulary, each carrying a typed input set, output set, tool binding, and parameters'). Implementation-defined. 'binding' is a tool operation from app/tools/catalog.py, an internal CADE step ('cade.*') or an analyst task ('analyst.*'). 'techniques' (ATT&CK IDs investigated) and 'consumes' (evidence categories) supply the IC and EA mappings (Section 5.1). Destructive actions take a 'verification_result' input and need a verification ancestor that verifies their 'target'.

actions.name: Extract entities and ATT&CK candidates
actions.description: Lift the grounded entities and validated ATT&CK candidates of the analysed incident into typed artifacts.

actions.name: Triage the alert
actions.description: Summarise severity, intent, evidence gaps and uncertainties of the analysed incident.

actions.name: Review recent host alerts
actions.description: Pull recent Wazuh alerts for the host to see related detections.

actions.name: Check file hash reputation
actions.description: Look up engine verdicts for a file hash.

actions.name: Check IP reputation
actions.description: Look up engine verdicts for an IP address.

actions.name: Check domain reputation
actions.description: Look up engine verdicts for a domain.

actions.name: Query process events
actions.description: Search process-start events (with command lines) on the host.

actions.name: Inspect process inventory
actions.description: List processes currently known to the Wazuh agent.

actions.name: Live process listing (osquery)
actions.description: List running processes and command lines with osquery.

actions.name: Analyse the process tree
actions.description: Look for suspicious parent/child chains, encoded commands and LOLBins.

actions.name: Query host network connections
actions.description: Search network connections made by the host.

actions.name: Query connections to an IP
actions.description: Find every internal host that talked to an IP address.

actions.name: Analyse network flows
actions.description: Look for beaconing, large transfers and traffic spikes.

actions.name: Query host DNS activity
actions.description: Search DNS queries made by the host.

actions.name: Query resolutions of a domain
actions.description: Find which hosts resolved a domain.

actions.name: Query a user's authentications
actions.description: Search logon events for the user account.

actions.name: Query logons on a host
actions.description: Search logon events on the host (remote logons, failures).

actions.name: Analyse authentication patterns
actions.description: Look for spraying, impossible travel and unusual remote logons.

actions.name: Query web server logs
actions.description: Search web access logs of the server.

actions.name: Query web requests from an IP
actions.description: Search web requests sent by a client IP.

actions.name: Query mailbox events
actions.description: Search email gateway events for the recipient.

actions.name: Analyse email artefacts
actions.description: Inspect senders, links and attachments of the messages.

actions.name: Query cloud audit trail
actions.description: Search cloud provider audit events for the account.

actions.name: Review file integrity events
actions.description: List recent file creations, modifications and deletions on the host.

actions.name: Select suspicious files
actions.description: Pick the files worth scanning (executables, recently written, unusual paths).

actions.name: Scan file with YARA
actions.description: Scan a suspicious file with the deployment's YARA rules.

actions.name: List scheduled tasks
actions.description: Enumerate scheduled tasks and their actions.

actions.name: Query registry activity
actions.description: Search the host's Sysmon registry events (12-14) for run keys, policy and security-tool changes.

actions.name: Query PowerShell script blocks
actions.description: Search the host's PowerShell script-block logs (4104) for decoded commands.

actions.name: Query service and scheduled-task creation
actions.description: Search the host's Security events 4697 / 4698 for new services and scheduled tasks.

actions.name: List autostart entries
actions.description: Enumerate run keys, services and startup folders.

actions.name: List listening ports
actions.description: List listening sockets and their processes.

actions.name: List local accounts
actions.description: Enumerate local accounts to spot newly created ones.

actions.name: Hunt with Sigma rules
actions.description: Run the Sigma rules tagged with a candidate ATT&CK technique across the SIEM.

actions.name: Acquire and triage memory
actions.description: Capture a memory image of the host and triage it (manual).

actions.name: Assess incident scope
actions.description: Combine findings to estimate affected hosts, accounts and data.

actions.name: Verify host compromise
actions.description: An analyst confirms from the findings that the host is compromised.

actions.name: Verify account compromise
actions.description: An analyst confirms from the findings that the account is compromised.

actions.name: Verify indicator is malicious
actions.description: Confirm an indicator only if its reputation verdict is malicious.

actions.name: Isolate host
actions.description: Cut the host off the network (Wazuh active response).

actions.name: Isolate host (Elastic Defend)
actions.description: Cut the host off the network with an Elastic Defend response action.

actions.name: Block IP on host firewall
actions.description: Drop traffic to/from the IP on the host (Wazuh firewall-drop).

actions.name: Block domain
actions.description: Sinkhole or block the domain at the DNS / proxy layer (manual).

actions.name: Disable account
actions.description: Disable the account in the directory (manual).

actions.name: Terminate process
actions.description: Terminate the malicious process on the host (manual).

actions.name: Quarantine file
actions.description: Move the malicious file to quarantine (manual).

actions.name: Remove persistence
actions.description: Delete the malicious scheduled task, service or run key (manual).

actions.name: Reset credentials
actions.description: Force a password reset and revoke sessions (manual).

actions.name: Restore host to service
actions.description: Release isolation / reimage once eradication is confirmed (manual).

actions.name: Notify stakeholders
actions.description: Inform system owners and management (manual).

actions.name: Generate incident report
actions.description: Compile all findings into the incident report (terminal action).
